title: Krisala Hiranandani Township Press & Digital PR Wire
description: Official Press Releases and Media Kits for the 105-Acre Krisala Hiranandani Integrated Equestrian Township in North Hinjewadi, Pune.

items.title: Krisala Developers & Hiranandani Communities Launch 105-Acre Integrated Equestrian Township in North Hinjewadi, Pune
items.content_html:
PUNE, MAHARASHTRA — In an unprecedented joint venture, Krisala Developers and Hiranandani Communities have unveiled their landmark 105-acre township, Hiranandani Pune, located in North Hinjewadi.

Featuring signature Greco-Roman architecture, India's first 8-acre private racecourse, and 40-acre Della resort lifestyle, the project offers 2, 3, 4 BHK and sky duplex residences. Homebuyers can access the official cost breakdown on the Hiranandani Price List 2026 portal.
items.summary: 105-Acre integrated township launch in North Hinjewadi featuring Neoclassical architecture, 8-acre private racecourse, and Della luxury resort precinct.

items.title: The Colosseum (Phase 4) Pre-Launch Window Announced at Krisala Hiranandani Township Hinjewadi
items.content_html:
PUNE, INDIA — Krisala Developers and Hiranandani Communities have announced pre-launch bookings for The Colosseum Phase 4 Hinjewadi, comprising B+G+27 storey Roman neoclassical towers.

Explore full inventory and floor plans at Krisala Hiranandani Township Hinjewadi.
items.summary: Exclusive pre-launch window for The Colosseum Phase 4 with B+G+27 neoclassical towers overlooking the Sahyadri mountains and private racecourse.
